open.EP.title: Folded to you in an early seat
open.EP.reason: Most of the table acts after you, and home game raises often get several callers, so open only your strongest hands.

open.LJ.title: Folded to you in the lojack

either.hands: 66, A9s, KTs, QTs, JTs, AJo, KQo

open.LJ.reason: Several players still act after you, so stay tight, but open a little more than the early seats.

open.HJ.title: Folded to you in the hijack

ranges.raise: 66+, A9s+, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, AJo+, KQo

open.HJ.reason: Fewer players are left behind you, so you can open more pairs, suited aces and high cards.

open.CO.title: Folded to you in the cutoff

ranges.raise: 55+, A2s+, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, T9s, ATo+, KJo+

either.hands: 22-44, K9s, Q9s, J9s, T8s, 98s, 87s, 76s, A9o, KTo, QJo

open.CO.reason: Only the button and the blinds are left, so open wide. The cutoff and the button are where home games are won.

open.BTN.title: Folded to you on the button

either.hands: K4s-K8s, Q7s-Q8s, J8s, T7s, 97s, 86s, 65s, 54s, A5o-A8o, K9o, Q9o, J9o, T9o, QTo, JTo

open.BTN.reason: You act last after the flop, the best seat at the table, so you open the most hands. Play 3 to 5 times as many hands here as from the first seat.

open.SB.title: Small blind, folded to you

either.hands: K4s-K8s, Q7s-Q8s, J8s, T7s, 97s, 86s, 65s, 54s, A5o-A8o, K9o, Q9o, J9o, T9o, QTo, JTo

open.SB.reason: Only the big blind is left, so play the button's hands. Raise or fold, never limp: you will act first on every street after the flop.

limpers.early.title: Facing limpers from an early or middle seat

either.hands: 77-99, ATs, AJs, KQs, KJs, QJs, AJo, KQo

limpers.early.reason: Raise your strong hands to punish the limpers. The more players limp, the tighter you raise, and with many players still behind you, do not limp along.

limpers.late.title: Facing limpers from the cutoff or button

either.hands: 77-99, ATs, AJs, KQs, KJs, QJs, JTs, AJo, KQo

limpers.late.reason: Raise your best hands. In position and at a cheap price, just call with small pairs, suited aces and suited connectors, which can win a big pot. Never limp behind with AA or KK.

limpers.SB.title: Small blind facing limpers

either.hands: 77-99, ATs, AJs, KQs, KJs, QJs, AJo, KQo

limpers.SB.reason: You already have half a bet in and the pot is big, so complete with almost anything suited, connected or ten high and better. Raise your strong hands and fold only real trash such as 83 or 72 offsuit.

limpers.BB.title: Big blind facing limpers

either.hands: 77-99, ATs, AJs, KQs, KJs, AJo, KQo

limpers.BB.reason: You see the flop for free, so check most hands. Raise your strong hands for value, and raise bigger because you will act first after the flop.

raise.vsEarly.title: Facing a raise from an early seat

either.hands: 22-77, ATs, AJs, KQs, KJs, QJs, JTs, T9s, 98s, AQo

raise.vsEarly.reason: An early raise means a strong hand. Re-raise only your best hands, call with pairs and suited hands that flop well, and fold offsuit hands like KJ and AT that are often beaten by a better kicker.

raise.vsLate.title: Facing a raise from a late seat

either.hands: 99, TT, AQo, AJs, ATs, KQs, KJs, QJs

raise.vsLate.reason: A late raiser opens many hands, so re-raise more hands for value. In position, call with pairs, suited aces and suited connectors. Players here call re-raises too often, so do not bluff.

bb.vsRaise.title: Big blind facing a raise

ranges.call: 22-99, A2s-AJs, KTs+, QTs+, JTs, T9s, 98s, 87s, 76s, 65s, 54s, AJo, KQo

either.hands: K9s, Q9s, J9s, T8s, 97s, 86s, 75s, 64s, 53s, ATo, KJo, KTo, QJo, QTo, JTo

bb.vsRaise.reason: You already have a big blind in and you close the action, so defend more hands than any other seat, mostly suited and connected ones. You act first after the flop, so fold weak offsuit hands.
